evidence.sentence: Our company exclusively deals in jewellery certified by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Hallmark, a widely recognized mark of purity that encourages additional confidence in consumers regarding the purity of our gold jewellery.
Quality Assurance 184 We hallmark all our gold products to ensure quality and purity of products, which is in line with the quality and purity metrics as prescribed by BIS.
- Further, concerning the quality control, we send all our jewellery to government-approved hallmarking centers who performs tests and analyses our jewellery in accordance with BIS norms.
